Subject: Pemberly Roofing - Submission Decline

Hi Marcus,

Thank you for thinking of us for Pemberly Roofing. Unfortunately, we'll need to pass on this opportunity for the following reasons:

• Roofing contractors fall outside our current appetite
• Two locations sit within coastal exposure zones (within 16 km of coast)
• We've reached our accumulation limits for coastal risks in this area

Given the coastal exposure and contractor class, I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty market, as they actively write roofing risks in coastal territories.

Happy to help with future submissions that fit our appetite better.

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
